fnol_text: My name is Ethan Ballard and I live at 377 Elmstead Place, Ashland, OR 97573. You can reach me on (555) 362-6828 or ethan.ballard@example.com. On 29 July 2024 the Stonebridge Brook overtopped near our house after a week of storms. River water flooded the downstairs rooms and the garage. Policy HH-2023-00019. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.
